verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs describe automating work through rule actions, webhooks and the API, plus AI Studio for no-code automations. AI Teammates and pre-built agents are described as working inside real workflows, with scoped permissions, audit trails and cost constraints, and Rules can trigger downstream actions such as PagerDuty incidents. That covers the core of background, autonomous automation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how AI Studio triggers, schedules or runs without supervision, and independent or hands-on confirmation that these automations reliably run autonomously.
